textbook.description: What the default (textbook) pattern expects a cycle to feel like, as the Hooper Index fatigue item (1 = very, very low, 7 = very, very high). It mirrors where phaseRules.json puts the heavy and light work: fresh through the follicular peak, most fatigued in the late luteal deload week. These are the app's modelling assumption, not measured values. The learning layer compares her logged fatigue against them.

expectedEffort.description: Session RPE (Borg CR-10, Foster session-RPE method) a session at this planned intensity is meant to feel like: 3 moderate, 5 hard, 7 very hard. Used for the planned session load (RPE x minutes) she is compared against.

learning.description: See PLAN.md, Learning layer. Only fatigue moves the plan: it is rated independently of what was prescribed, so dialing a week down does not erase the evidence that moved it. Session RPE and load are shown alongside as a check.

trainingDays.description: Day offsets within the 7-day block, by training days per week.

goalTemplates.description: Slot for the Nth training day of the week, by goal.
